---

## 1. Brand Overview & Philosophy

Vespera Caviar is an independent, direct-to-consumer luxury caviar house based in New York City. Founded on the principle of restraint, transparency, and uncompromised freshness, Vespera operates without brick-and-mortar storefront markups or intermediate distributor holding periods.

### Core Distinctions
- **Never Frozen**: Freezing caviar compromises the delicate cell membrane of the roe, destroying the distinctive "pop" and altering the mouthfeel. Every Vespera tin is shipped fresh in a refrigerated state.
- **Traditional Malossol Cure**: Prepared with pure salt concentrations at or below 3.5–4% (malossol translates to "little salt" in Russian), accentuating the natural nutty, buttery lipid nuances of the sturgeon roe rather than masking them with excess salinity.
- **Traceable Sustainable Aquaculture**: Harvested exclusively from world-class sustainable sturgeon farms operating with pure spring-fed or recirculating closed-loop systems, adhering strictly to CITES (Convention on International Trade in Endangered Species) conservation protocols.
- **Packed to Order in New York**: Tins are filled, hermetically sealed, and temperature-verified in New York on the exact day of dispatch.

## 2. Comprehensive Product Catalogue

### Product 1: Siberian Sturgeon Classic
- **Canonical URL**: https://www.vesperacaviar.com/siberian
- **Sturgeon Species**: *Acipenser baerii* (Siberian Sturgeon)
- **Egg Diameter**: Medium (2.5 mm – 2.8 mm)
- **Color Profile**: Dark charcoal to shimmering jet-black
- **Texture**: Clean, resilient pop with velvety dispersion
- **Tasting Profile**: Pronounced nutty core, earthy mineral undertones, and a crisp, faintly spicy finish
- **Available Sizes**: 1 oz (28g) tin, 2 oz (56g) tin
- **Ideal Pairings**:
  - Beverage: Brut Nature Champagne, Vintage Blanc de Blancs, chilled crisp mineral vodka (e.g., Belvedere Single Estate Rye)
  - Food: Buckwheat blinis, cultured crème fraîche, steamed fingerling potatoes, soft-scrambled eggs
- **Recommended Audience**: Benchmark everyday luxury for both newcomers and seasoned caviar enthusiasts.

### Product 2: Kaluga Fusion Reserve
- **Canonical URL**: https://www.vesperacaviar.com/kaluga
- **Sturgeon Species**: *Huso dauricus* × *Acipenser schrenckii* (Kaluga × Amur Sturgeon Hybrid)
- **Egg Diameter**: Large (3.0 mm – 3.2 mm)
- **Color Profile**: Deep olive green, amber, to golden-brown translucent pearls
- **Texture**: Plump, glossy, supple yielding pop with rich lipid melt
- **Tasting Profile**: Creamy butteriness layered with mild sea brine, toasted brioche, hazelnut, and an unhurried, gentle finish
- **Available Sizes**: 1 oz (28g) tin, 2 oz (56g) tin
- **Ideal Pairings**:
  - Beverage: Prestige Cuvée Champagne (e.g., Dom Pérignon, Krug Grand Cuvée), white Burgundy (Chablis Grand Cru, Meursault)
  - Food: Brioche toast points, sea urchin (uni), raw Hokkaido scallop crudo, dry-aged beef tartare
- **Recommended Audience**: Sophisticated centerpiece selection for dinner parties, private tastings, and formal entertainment.

### Product 3: Imperial Kaluga Fusion
- **Canonical URL**: https://www.vesperacaviar.com/imperial
- **Sturgeon Species**: *Huso dauricus* × *Acipenser schrenckii* (Top 5% Selection by Master Grader)
- **Egg Diameter**: Extra-Large / Oversized (3.3 mm – 3.6 mm)
- **Color Profile**: Glistening bronze, warm golden-amber, and rich olive luster
- **Texture**: Unusually firm yet silky, burst of unctuous lipid richness
- **Tasting Profile**: Intensely rich, decadent dairy creaminess, profound walnut/almond depth, lingering savory umami; universally considered the modern sustainable equivalent to legendary wild Beluga (*Huso huso*).
- **Available Sizes**: 1 oz (28g) tin, 2 oz (56g) tin
- **Ideal Pairings**:
  - Beverage: Rare vintage Champagne, Grand Cru Blanc de Noirs, premium Junmai Daiginjo Sake
  - Food: Served strictly purist style on crushed ice with mother-of-pearl spoons
- **Recommended Audience**: Connoisseurs, collectors, gala milestones, and top-tier luxury gifting.

## 3. Storage, Handling & Serving Protocol

| Step | Recommendation | Rationale |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Receipt & Immediate Storage** | Refrigerate at 28°F – 32°F (-2°C to 0°C) immediately. | The back/bottom shelf of the refrigerator is coldest; avoid refrigerator door compartments where temperature fluctuates. |
| **Unopened Shelf Life** | Refer to best-by date printed on tin base (typically 3–4 weeks from packing). | Tins are sealed in an anaerobic state with malossol preservation. |
| **Post-Opening Shelf Life** | Consume within 24 to 72 hours of opening. | Exposure to ambient air oxidizes delicate lipids. |
| **Service Utensils** | Use natural mother-of-pearl, buffalo horn, bone, or gold-plated spoons. | Sterling silver, stainless steel, and iron cause metallic oxidation that impairs flavor. |
| **Service Temperature** | Place tin directly in a bowl of crushed ice during consumption. | Keeps roe at optimal crisp texture throughout service. |

## 4. Cold-Chain Logistics & Delivery

- **Origin**: New York, NY
- **Shipping Provider**: Priority Overnight Courier (FedEx Priority Overnight / UPS Next Day Air Early AM)
- **Packaging Technology**: Vacuum-insulated thermal shipping container, reusable frozen polar gel packs / dry ice buffer, tamper-evident vacuum tin tape.
- **Delivery Schedule**: Tuesday through Friday delivery across the Continental United States. Saturday delivery available via Private Client request.

## 6. Comprehensive Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ)

**Q: Is Vespera Caviar ever frozen during transit or storage?**  
A: No. Vespera caviar is never frozen at any stage of harvesting, curing, packing, or delivery. It travels in custom temperature-controlled cold cases that maintain 28–32°F throughout overnight transit.

**Q: What does "Malossol" mean?**  
A: "Malossol" is the Russian word for "little salt" (typically ≤3.5% to 4% salt by weight). It is the hallmark of high-grade artisanal caviar, ensuring the pure, natural flavor of the sturgeon roe takes center stage without harsh saltiness.

**Q: How is Vespera caviar farmed sustainably?**  
A: Vespera collaborates exclusively with state-of-the-art aquaculture farms that raise sturgeon in pristine spring water environments. All sturgeon are CITES-certified with complete genomic and regional traceability.

**Q: How do I order from Vespera?**  
A: Orders are placed through the private client portal at https://www.vesperacaviar.com/contact or by contacting info@vesperacaviar.com.
